_note: Story Testraum (src/debug/story_testraum.gd; user decision 2026-10-31): one room of floor 1 of a story world with a fold-out debug panel under the mini-map (src/debug/story_testraum_panel.gd) and its tools (src/debug/story_testraum_tools.gd). It replaces the old crypt Testraum (src/debug/test_arena.gd, assets/data/debug_test_arena.json) in the DEBUG hub. The Testraum plays on its own profile and soul-crystal files, never the player's.
_room_note: The biggest open room of floor 1 (most floor cells), not of these types. Every room counts as cleared: no fight starts, the doors stay open. The hero falls and stands up again revive_at s before the run would end (dead counts down from 1.8 s); card offers stay closed (no_cards).
_defaults_note: Panel settings of a fresh Testraum (carried over world and class switches). ai: on | new (new spawns are training dummies) | all (every monster is one). numbers, parts, readout: the damage numbers, the parts / hit-zone overlay and the element readout under the mouse. filter: the search text; recent: the ZULETZT row.
_spawn_note: Spawns at distance px from the hero in his aim direction, spread rad apart; bosses one at a time at boss_distance. Armed with the mouse: the first on the clicked floor, the others on a ring of mouse_ring px round it.
_sets_note: The hell_monsters.gd monster sets merged into the running monster runtime of the Krypta and the Hölle (defs, atlas, exp from the balance file); world: the world pack whose floors name the guardians' HP.
_roster_note: runtime monsters: hell_monsters.gd defs, spawnable in the Krypta and the Hölle (both sets merged). runtime theme: the Frostgruft's theme mobs (frost_theme.json mobs) and its floor guardians (frost_world.json floors, boss_kits on 3/6/9/10); they run only in the Frostgruft's own loop (hell_game.gd _update_mobs), so they are greyed out elsewhere, and the hell_monsters sets are greyed out in the Frostgruft (it has no monster runtime). The search field matches name, id and tag (umlauts folded).
_npcs_note: Entities of type npc next to the hero (the merchant figure of the world kit's shop room, world_core.gd); greyed out where the world's sprite set lacks its frames (tex).
_elements_note: Click tools: arm one, then every left click on the floor places it (the hero does not attack meanwhile), right click or Esc lays it down. Puddles are hell_monsters.gd puddle zones (st = vfx_pools.json material; frozen: water frozen by frost_at after freeze_delay s), gases src/vfx/gas.gd clouds (vfx_gas.json), reactions src/hell/story_elements.gd. needs monsters: only with the monster runtime (Krypta, Hölle); the Frostgruft has none.

elements._kraft_note: The force tools (src/debug/story_testraum_tools.gd aims and draws them; their element work is src/hell/story_elements.gd lightning_at / wave_at / quake_at / holy_at). Distances world px (96 px cells; crypt px x 1.5 = PIXEL_WORLD / 2), damage in hero hits (x state.dmg, as story_elements explode_hits), bosses take boss_share of damage, stun and push. blitz: the bolt from the hero's hand to the monster nearest the click (within chain_reach), then jumps more to the next within chain_range, each hit falloff x the last; every bolt charges the puddles within reach (crypt reach 24 px). charge (src/data/balance.json element: charge_time, charge_tick, charge_stun as there; its charge_damage 2 crypt HP becomes charge_hits 0.5 hero hits per tick, about one hero hit a second in the water): lightning into a liquid that conducts charges it, every monster standing in it is hurt and stunned each tick, the hero is spared, Glatteis insulates. sturm: a storm over r for time s striking a random point every s (seek: share that strikes a monster in it), each strike strike_r round, from height px above. druckwelle: gas blown away (gas.impulse strength gas), liquid ringing (ripple, rings points), monsters thrown back push px/s. beben: cracks, chunks knocked up, ice cracking, monsters on their feet stunned stun s. heilig: undead and void creatures (element tags or words in id / name) hurt, the hero in the light heals heal half hearts.

_tools_note: WERKZEUGE (src/debug/story_testraum_tools.gd). ai: the KI choices (training dummies stand and attack nothing: hell monsters through hell_monsters.gd ai_off, theme mobs held in place). toggles: panel settings of defaults. numbers: damage numbers over a hit monster (screen px pixel font: size, crit_size; rise px over life s, crits life x 1.25 and pop s bigger; jitter px sideways; max on screen); the element colour: the hero's own hit by class_el, an element hit (story_elements hurt_mob last_el), else a status (status_el), else class_el. dps: the meter over the last window s. parts: the overlay of the monster nearest the mouse within pick_reach px (part boxes by HP share: ok >= 0.6 > hurt >= 0.3 > low; lost; the hit zone circle). readout: its box offset px from the mouse (a box that would reach under the panel, within panel_gap px, flips to the left) and the names of the materials.
_armor_note: RÜSTUNGEN (src/debug/story_testraum.gd _rows_armor): every power armour of items.json (gear with power, src/hero/armor_powers.gd) into the bag, known and clean; the hero class first, the others carry their class (other: %s the class id) and show the class lock in the inventory. given: the toast (%s the name).

_panel_note: Layout px of the panel column under the mini-map (src/ui/hud_kit.gd menu_rect): gap to the ESC chip, chip height, inner pad, extra height of a row over the small font (rows at least min_row high), text pad of a button, gap between rows, space kept free at the bottom, wheel step.
